fact: The World Bank reports that Mozambique's national meteorology institute INAM produces its weather warnings from satellite images, radar and observation-network data.

The World Bank reports that INAM issues weather warnings based on satellite images, radar and network data, which the Instituto de Comunicação Social then relays through 70 community radios and community brigades.
WMO says Mozambique's meteorological warnings are based on forecasts using satellite imagery and surface observation data.
WMO says meteorological warnings based on satellite-aided forecasts were disseminated through community radio and volunteers, and ahead of Cyclone Freddy in 2023.
